description: Översvämningskartering 2019 i Trollhättans kommun is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trollhättans stad. The flood mapping for Trollhättan municipality is based on modeling of extreme rainfall events to assess the risks and impacts of flooding from 2019. The dataset consists of two main components: Flow Velocity This dataset presents water flow speeds during various flood scenarios. Coverage: Trollhättans stad. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Mapping 2019 in Trollhättan Municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Trollhättans stad. Its keywords include Maxdjup, Klimatanpassning, 100-year rain, Spatial data, Flödeshastighet, Riskanalys. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
